size.value: 4.5 x 3.5 cm (i.e. 3.5×4.5cm), conforming to ICAO standards

face_visibility.value: A recent color photograph of the full face (frontal view)

file_spec.value: Must be a recent color photo, not drawn/copied from a previous photo. Must be certified: the owner's name, file number, and place of registered residence written on it, signed and stamped with the mayor's (mukhtar's) seal.

face_visibility.en: A recent full-face color photograph (frontal view).
face_visibility.ko: 정면을 향한 얼굴 전체가 나오는 최근 촬영 컬러 사진.
face_visibility.ja: 正面を向いた顔全体が写る、最近撮影したカラー写真。

cross_verification.note: Lebanese General Security (GDGS, general-security.gov.lb) is the sole authority for passports in Lebanon. Page /en/posts/80 is titled 'Passport picture requirements' but its specification text is embedded in images (res1-3.jpg) that could not be retrieved (image host returned HTML/404 rather than the image binary). The verbatim quote used here — 'A recent color photograph of the full face on a white background, conforming to the standards of the International Civil Aviation Organization (ICAO) measuring 4.5 x 3.5 cm...certified by the mayor's seal and signature after writing the name of the owner of the photo, file number and statistical statement' — comes from /en/posts/196, which covers biometric passport issuance for Palestinian refugees registered in Lebanon specifically, but restates the same general GDGS ICAO photo standard. size and background both match DB exactly (3.5×4.5cm; white).
